title: Coverings of semi-representable objects are stable under composition and base change
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ the category of semi-representable objects over $X$, with its coverings [def-weil-pbc-semi-representable-object]. (1) If $a:K\to L$ and $b:L\to M$ are coverings in $\mathrm{SR}(X)$, then $b\circ a:K\to M$ is a covering. (2) If $a:K\to L$ is a covering and $c:L'\to L$ is any morphism of $\mathrm{SR}(X)$, then the projection $L'\times_LK\to L'$ from the fibre product in $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ is a covering.
